creditor: R Interface to the Loro CRDT Library

Source: R/creditor-package.R
creditor-package.Rd

Exploratory R bindings to the loro Rust crate. Start with loro_doc(), get container handles with doc_text(), doc_map(), and doc_list(), edit them with the text_*, map_*, and list_* functions, and move changes between replicas with doc_export(), doc_export_updates(), and doc_import().
